name: smwgraphics-five-nights-at-freddy-s-freddy
title: Five Nights at Freddy's - Freddy
description:
This is Freddy Fazbear from the Five Nights at Freddy's series.

This is an updated version, with some changes to a few frames, such as the swimming animation.

Includes overworld, Yoshi, P-Baloon and cutscene frames, but no cape frames because it gets misplaced with these graphics.

There's a patch that will change Mario to Freddy in the file select and the "Mario/Luigi Start!" messages, though the lives exchanger text will not be edited because his name is 6 characters long.

The OW palette is to be inserted as a normal palette, in all maps. Player 2 will also a slightly brighter palette.

You'll need to apply the 32x32 player tilemap patch to use these graphics.
